decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core cutting and creasing range, it remains inexpensive to carry and its option value is still higher than the value of abandoning it now.

Because the UV spot varnishing system is more distant from the established portfolio its abandonment risk is the highest, but its flagship role in print enhancement and digital finishing still justifies keeping the option open for another year.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on existing customer workflows and can be maintained in the portfolio at low incremental cost while market uptake becomes clearer.
The B2-format multifinisher is both strategically emphasized and closely aligned with the firm's established postpress business, making early withdrawal unlikely.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's familiar booklet-making and binding domain, so with no visible negative signal there is little reason to close this option yet.
The folding add-on unit appears to be a low-cost complementary option with at least one market reference, so retaining it is more attractive than dropping it now.
